s: The avatar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
The avatar makes a number of Reaping Scythe attacks equal to half the summoner's Proficiency Bonus (rounded up).
{@atkr m} Automatic hit, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Necrotic damage.
